prompt: Read files/agent-context.json. List each resource's label, type, region, and account. No analysis needed.
expected_output: Lists every resource from files/agent-context.json with its label, type, region, and account exactly as defined in the file.

prompt: According to the skill, what are the three verifiability classifications for a check, and how must the report treat each with respect to a Passed status? No account access required.
expected_output: Names Verifiable, Heuristic, and Prescribe-only. Verifiable: Passed/Failed/N/A strictly from returned data. Heuristic: cite evidence, N/A (not Passed) when ambiguous or denied. Prescribe-only: always N/A, never Passed/Failed.

prompt: For check BR-14 (stale Bedrock access), what status must the skill emit under the DevOps Agent, and why? No account access required.
expected_output: BR-14 is Prescribe-only and is always reported N/A because it requires iam:GenerateServiceLastAccessedDetails, a Generate* verb blocked by the DevOps Agent read-only guardrail; it must never be Passed or Failed.

prompt: What does this skill defer to bedrock-adoption-readiness, aiml-access-diagnostics, and agentcore-observability-setup? No account access required.
expected_output: Defers production-adoption readiness (ZDR, quota/capacity headroom, observability maturity) to bedrock-adoption-readiness; reactive diagnosis of a specific access denial to aiml-access-diagnostics; AgentCore observability (and all AgentCore) to agentcore-observability-setup.

prompt: Is this a read-only assessment, and what verbs is the skill allowed to call? Can it remediate findings automatically? No account access required.
expected_output: Strictly read-only: only Describe*/List*/Get*/BatchGet* calls; never creates, modifies, deletes, enables, or disables anything, and never calls Generate* verbs. It does not remediate; it reports guidance only.
assertions: does not contain 'will remediate' or does not contain 'automatically fix'

prompt: What fields must each finding contain and what pattern must Check_ID match? Name the allowed Status values. No account access required.
expected_output: Fields: Check_ID, Finding, Finding_Details, Resolution, Reference, Severity, Status, Verifiability, Region (and optional Account). Check_ID matches ^BR-\d{2}$. Status is one of Failed, Passed, N/A.

prompt: According to the skill, when does check BR-23 (guardrail content filter coverage) fail versus pass? No account access required.
expected_output: BR-23 fails when a guardrail is missing any of the four content filters (hate, insults, sexual, violence) or lacks configured thresholds, and passes only when all four are enabled with thresholds; N/A when no guardrails exist.
